title: Managed Backup: billing calendar
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines billing calendar.

## Tier basis

**Billing timezone.** Timezone used for calendar boundaries; IANA timezone string.

**Billing cycle.** Recurring invoice window basis; string.

| Contract tier | Billing timezone | Billing cycle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | UTC | Calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | UTC | Calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | UTC | Calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | UTC | Calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | UTC | Calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | UTC | Calendar month |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, billing timezone is UTC.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, billing timezone stays the same.
